text:
maria_cs: Skylark Labs filed an intake for a private multimodal "reranker" to handle invoices + attached photos. They explicitly require VPC-only, bring-your-own-key (HSM/KMS), and a q13b-int8 variant. They called this a make-or-break feature for their Q4 renewal. Link to intake: https://forms.company/skylark-onboard. Can infra triage?

skylark-csm: Quick context: ~10k monthly requests today, expect peak bursts ~200 qps during payroll windows. Data has PII but not PHI. Must prove no data leaves their VPC and audit logs for KMS access.

sam_eng: Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) sample payloads (anonymized) + size distribution of images, 2) their acceptable latency envelope (p50/p95). Do they want streaming?

skylark-csm: We'll provide a sample bundle (up to 4k examples) and latency goal: p95 <= 300ms, p50 <= 90ms. Streaming not required, prefer sync.

elaine_sec: Security checklist: need AFA signed, formal KMS policy, proof of HSM attestation (customer-specified model key owner). Also recommend client-side encryption for image uploads. We'll request SOC2 scope confirmation.

priya_prod: Product reqs: recommend Dedicated/Private with reserved nodes. For reranker, set safety filters for PII leakage and hallucination scoring. Eval targets: MAP@10 >= 0.75 vs their baseline, and false-positive rate on PHI redaction < 0.05%. We'll run a 2-week canary with automatic rollback on safety regressions.

tony_sre: Initial perf calc: assuming 13B quantized on A10G class nodes, 3 replicas autoscaled for burst, we estimate p95 of 220-280ms depending on image preproc time. Need exact image dims and preprocessing steps to finalize. I'll prep a draft bill-of-resources and cost delta for Private vs Dedicated.

sam_eng: For onboarding pipeline, I'll ask for S3 staging permissions (temp creds), an eval manifest, and expected schema. Example staging config we plan to run: ```yaml
model: skylark-reranker-13b-q8
private: true
BYOK: true
batching:
  max_tokens: 512
  image_batching: 1
latency_slo: 300ms_p95
```
Will request their devs to join a 60-min tech onboarding session.

ops-bot: Ticket created: ORG-4907. Owners: sam_eng, maria_cs. SLA: initial triage 48h, plan due in 7 days.

maria_cs: Heads-up: renewals team notified; CM will attach success milestones to the renewal offer. Skylark asked for an enablement workshop for their ops + security teams next Wed afternoon.

skylark-csm: Confirmed. We'll send sample bundle and calendar invite for the workshop today. Thanks team! :rocket:
